observations.note: round-1 MAJOR resolved; को after a weekday is standard 'on <day>', idiomatic, not a calque
date + को + clock is standard Hindi date-time phrasing; a comma joiner would also be acceptable, no replacement needed
आज/कल take no postposition; difference from weekday/date is grammatical, not inconsistent
बजे deliberately absent because {time} already carries the Intl hi day-period; appending it would double
कल also means 'tomorrow'; context (past-message meta row) disambiguates; no better single word
